cases.sentence: Он видел, что его герой и командир находился совсем в ___ мыслей.
cases.explain: «другом строе» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: “Well, is she pretty? Ah, friend—my pink one is delicious; her name is Dunyásha. …” But on glancing at Rostóv’s face Ilyín stopped short. He saw that his hero and commander was following quite a different train of thought.

cases.sentence: Ростов злобно оглянулся на Ильина и, не отвечая ему, ___ направился к деревне.
cases.explain: «быстрыми шагами» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Rostóv glanced angrily at Ilyín and without replying strode off with rapid steps to the village.

cases.sentence: Он говорил, что мужики находились в закоснелости, что в настоящую минуту было неблагоразумно противуборствовать им, не имея ___, что не лучше ли бы было послать прежде за командой.
cases.explain: «военной команды» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: “Decision? What decision? Old dotard! …” cried he. “What have you been about? Eh? The peasants are rioting, and you can’t manage them? You’re a traitor yourself! I know you. I’ll flay you all alive! …” And as if afraid of wasting his store of anger, he left Alpátych and went rapidly forward. Alpátych, mastering his offended feelings, kept pace with Rostóv at a gliding gait and continued to impart his views. He said the peasants were obdurate and that at the present moment it would be imprudent to “overresist” them without an armed force, and would it not be better first to send for the military?

cases.sentence: Дрон был того же мнения; но как только он выразил его, так Карп и ___ напали на бывшего старосту.
cases.explain: «другие мужики» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: After the hussars had come to the village and Rostóv had gone to see the princess, a certain confusion and dissension had arisen among the crowd. Some of the peasants said that these new arrivals were Russians and might take it amiss that the mistress was being detained. Dron was of this opinion, but as soon as he expressed it Karp and others attacked their ex-Elder.

cases.sentence: — Очередь на твоего сына была, а ты небось гладуха своего пожалел, — вдруг быстро заговорил ___, нападая на Дрона, — а моего Ваньку забрил.
cases.explain: «маленький старичок» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “It was your son’s turn to be conscripted, but no fear! You begrudged your lump of a son,” a little old man suddenly began attacking Dron—“and so they took my Vánka to be shaved for a soldier! But we all have to die.”

cases.sentence: Дрон напротив зашел в ___, и толпа сдвинулась плотнее.
cases.explain: «задние ряды» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: The two tall peasants had their say. As soon as Rostóv, followed by Ilyín, Lavrúshka, and Alpátych, came up to the crowd, Karp, thrusting his fingers into his belt and smiling a little, walked to the front. Dron on the contrary retired to the rear and the crowd drew closer together.

cases.explain: «быстрым шагом» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “Who is your Elder here? Hey?” shouted Rostóv, coming up to the crowd with quick steps.

cases.sentence: Но не успел он договорить, как шапка слетела с него и голова мотнулась на бок от ___.
cases.explain: «сильного удара» — after the preposition «от», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: But before the words were well out of his mouth, his cap flew off and a fierce blow jerked his head to one side.

cases.explain: «полнокровный голос» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: “Caps off, traitors!” shouted Rostóv in a wrathful voice. “Where’s the Elder?” he cried furiously.

cases.explain: «неистовым голосом» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “Caps off, traitors!” shouted Rostóv in a wrathful voice. “Where’s the Elder?” he cried furiously.
